findings.evidence: _search_shard sets `rerank_invoked = bool(self._reranker and fused)` before the `if fused and ticket is not None:` block (body not in the visible diff). If a shard can have non-empty fused yet skip the actual rerank call (ticket None), rerank_eligible overcounts and the acceptance ratio rerank_rrf/r
findings.title: Eligibility flag computed before the gated rerank invocation

findings.evidence: The validator only applies fallback checks inside `if self.rerank_fallback_model:`, so with backend cohere, BRAIN_RERANK_FALLBACK_PROVIDER alone is accepted, never routing-validated, and build_reranker_client returns the single primary — the operator's setting has no effect and no error surfaces.
findings.title: Fallback provider without fallback model is silently ignored

findings.evidence: RerankChain checks is_calibrated only for the fallback, then computes math.log(primary_floor/(1-primary_floor)); if calibration_for_identity's unknown-identity default search_min_score is 0.0 or 1.0, an uncalibrated primary plus a configured fallback would raise a math domain error or ZeroDivisionEr
findings.title: Logit shift built from the primary floor without a calibrated-primary check
